name: Gianvito Rossi
band_note: shoe house, banded on shoe entry $795 (women's price pass, 2026-10-13)
why: Women's pumps, sandals and boots made in Italy, with the Gianvito 105 pump at $850, sold through its own boutiques and site and department stores.
origin: Founded in Milan, Italy in 2006 by Gianvito Rossi.

ownership.owner: Compagnie Financière Richemont SA (SIX: CFR), controlling stake

quote.q: What I like is offering shoes that enhances women and their silhouette, rather than seeing the products prevail over them…

opview: “What I like is offering shoes that enhances women and their silhouette, rather than seeing the products prevail over them…” — Gianvito Rossi, founder, The Maison, gianvitorossi.com

facts_read.source: brand site; richemont.com Our Maisons; World Footwear 2023-08-01; nordstrom.com; Vinted brand page; TRR designer directory; B Lab directory; GOTS database

doors.note: US: 5 own doors — South Coast Plaza (Costa Mesa), NorthPark (Dallas), Crystal Shops (Las Vegas), Bal Harbour, Madison Avenue (New York) — and 1 concession, Bloomingdale's NYC, which is listed as one of 'Our Boutiques' with its own Gianvito Rossi shop email. Store pages give no ZIP and, outside California, no state. World: 50 boutiques; 18 of them sit inside department stores (Harrods, Le Bon Marché, Galeries Lafayette, La Rinascente x2, Bloomingdale's x3, Printemps Doha, Japanese department stores x6, Shinsegae, El Corte Inglés, Globus). No stockist list.
